note: What a server sends to put a lasting effect in a slot that already holds one, keeping the slot rather than taking the old one off first. The header names the unit carrying the effect, which can differ from the caster named inside.

fields.name: slot
fields.note: Which of the unit's effect slots. A client ignores the message where it is above 63.

fields.name: runningFor
fields.note: How long the effect has already run, in seconds.

fields.name: lasts
fields.note: How long it runs in total, in seconds. A client applies a value below zero as given; a server sends zero or more.

fields.name: caster
fields.note: The unit that put it there.
